name: Fukuoka (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Fukuoka city emblem in violet: nine katakana フ (fu) rendered as lozenges and arranged in a triangular cluster.
history: The emblem, a rebus arranging nine フ marks (fu × ku = 'Fuku'), was adopted in 1909.

features.role: Fukuoka city emblem — nine フ lozenges in a triangle
features.symbolism: a rebus on the city's name: nine (ku) フ (fu) marks read 'fuku'
